title: Crimson Empire: Circumstances to Serve a Noble
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sheila, sold into servitude as a child and told by a demonic figure that she has a destiny, is trained by an assassins' guild and then placed with Prince Edvard as head maid and bodyguard (Seven Seas blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). She foils plots against him in a succession struggle while many men at court court her. Three-volume josei adaptation of a QuinRose otome game.
life_message: Fierce loyalty and competence can give a person bought and sold like property a place and purpose of her own (to verify).

folkways.japan: A European-styled court seen through Japanese otome-game conventions, with loyal service to one master echoing shujū (lord-retainer) ideals.
